derivedFrom: Film re-record on design C, recording R2 (2026-11-08, after review R1). Recorder, DOM probes and scans: scripts/film/ (record.mjs probes, scan.mjs scans); run report: outputs/tavonel-research-replan-20261013/design-20261104/impl/ (ai-knowledge-compiler).
method: The cuts are recordings of the real product UI, so strings are read from the DOM, not transcribed: the recorder itself (record.mjs, the 2x capture run) records, at each sampled second, every visible occurrence of each of the stage's probe strings (Range.getBoundingClientRect, x2 for source px). t=18 is frame 449 (17.96 s). pane = the quarter column of the 2880x1800 frame (the cuts have no drawn panes).

cropCheck.method: Re-record: yAt = the top edge (source px) of each probed occurrence inside the crop window's columns at each sampled second; insideWindow = sampled seconds where one occurrence lies wholly inside rows crop.y*1800 .. +900. A recording scrolls, so the window is held to the same 80% rule as visibleAt: holdsTarget = insideWindow / samples >= 0.8. A stage whose window does not hold its target opens on Fit. smallestXHeight: product UI type in the recordings is >= 12px CSS, i.e. >= 11 source px of x-height at 2x; embedded page renders (the PDF pages and reference renders shown inside the product) are excluded and carry smaller type. At 1440 the film is drawn 1240/1440 wide, so 12px UI type shows at about 10.3px.

smallestXHeight.text: 12px CSS product type (Wanted Sans / Plex Mono), drawn at 24 source px; x-height 0.46-0.52 of the em. Embedded page renders (the PDF pages and reference renders on screen) are excluded: their type is the filing's own, at the page's scale
smallestXHeight.at: every frame: the recording is the product UI at deviceScaleFactor 2

blankScan.method: Re-record: the Release 3 cell rule over the stage's whole 2x crop window (columns crop.x .. crop.x + 0.5 split into its two panes, rows crop.y .. crop.y + 0.5), on all 450 source PNG frames of each cut (2880x1800, the frames the cut was encoded from). 24x24 source-px cells from the window origin; a cell holds ink when its luma range (sampled every 2px) is >= 48; a pane is blank when >= blankAt of its cells hold none. share = frames with neither pane blank / frames. defaultView crop only when share >= threshold and the window holds the reading target (cropCheck.holdsTarget).
blankScan.receipt: scripts/film/ (record.mjs probes, scan.mjs scans); run report: outputs/tavonel-research-replan-20261013/design-20261104/impl/ (ai-knowledge-compiler)

phonePaneScan.method: Re-record: the blankScan cell rule over one w x w*5/4 source-px rect at the stage's phonePane, on all 450 source frames; a frame is blank when >= blankAt of the rect's cells hold none. share = frames not blank / frames; a phonePane is used only when share >= threshold. All four rects are 684 px wide (the spec ceiling), so 12px CSS product type draws at about 12.5px on a 390 phone.
phonePaneScan.receipt: scripts/film/ (record.mjs probes, scan.mjs scans); run report: outputs/tavonel-research-replan-20261013/design-20261104/impl/ (ai-knowledge-compiler)
phonePaneScan.rect: per stage: phonePane.w x phonePane.w * 5 / 4 source px (4:5)

edgeBandScan.method: Review R1 MAJOR-1: a frame has an edge band when any of its top or bottom 16 source-px rows has a full-width mean luma < 60 (scan.mjs edgeBand; record.mjs retakes such a capture). bandFrames = frames of the 450 with a band.
